voice: Champion (ElevenLabs Callum N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO): a weary survivor's last words before the Guardian's judgement

lines.LW_01: Today is not my day... but I hope my people survive.
lines.LW_02: Tell my people I tried. Tell them to keep sailing.
lines.LW_03: So this is where my road ends. Look after them for me.
lines.LW_04: I came so far... Please. Let my people find a home.
lines.LW_05: Don't mourn me. Just don't let them forget why we came.
lines.LW_06: I'm sorry. I wanted to bring them home.
lines.LW_07: Not like this... Forgive me, my people.
lines.LW_08: Keep the fires burning. One of us has to make it.
